name: Liquid hydrogen carriers
applications: long-distance hydrogen trade, Australia to Japan
principle: Hydrogen is liquefied at -253 °C and carried in double-insulated tanks. Kawasaki's Suiso Frontier, launched 11 December 2019 with 1,250 m³ capacity, made the first Japan-Australia voyage in January 2022 with a gas-control-system malfunction at Hastings port on 25 January 2022.

source.note: Wikipedia, Suiso Frontier, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)
Wikipedia, Suiso Frontier, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

performance.metric: Suiso Frontier liquefied-hydrogen carrier (world's first LH2 ship)
performance.unit: m3 LH2 tank capacity (1,250 cbm), about 75 t LH2 per cargo, 116 m and about 8,000 t displacement
performance.basis: maiden international LH2 voyage Hastings (Victoria, Australia) to Kobe, Japan, delivered February 2022; boil-off rate not published in open pages

source.note: LNG Prime, 28 Feb 2022 (1,250 cbm, first shipment); lngprime Jan 2022 (75 t cargo, 116 m, 8,000 t); read 2026-10-28
